limitations: Integer initial states only; no real-neighborhood stability claim.
Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
Historical priority remains provisional given one incompletely accessible 2007 related publication.
scientific_integrity: Universal statements are proved for Z^2 and positive integer balanced c, using exhaustive branch reasoning plus explicit cycle certificates. Finite computations are supplementary and cannot certify arbitrary real or rational states.
title: Global integer-orbit collapse and a four-period plateau in a balanced ultradiscrete predator–prey map
